description: An unfinished module for endless-encoder MIDI controllers: it reads control change messages as movement rather than position, builds a voltage from them and sends it back out as control change

params.text: Scales how far one control change message moves the voltage, from a tenth to nearly twice the default step
Follows the voltage built from whatever control change last arrived, 0 to 10V; turning it by hand sends control change 10 out of the MIDI output

inputs.text: Nothing in the module reads this jack. No input is read anywhere in the module's code.

outputs.text: The voltage built from whatever control change last arrived, 0 to 10V

notes: nothing happens until a MIDI input and a MIDI output device are chosen with the two buttons at the top. Those buttons are not parameters, so clicking one for help gives nothing.
the module tracks all 128 controllers but has one knob and one jack to show them on, so what appears there is whichever controller moved last. This is as far as the maker got.
menu: Panic — clears every stored controller value and re-opens both MIDI ports
